class.name: CameraTexture
class.description: This texture gives access to the camera texture provided by a [CameraFeed]. [method Texture.get_data] returns an independent RGBA snapshot when CPU capture is supported by the selected feed. [b]Note:[/b] Many cameras supply YCbCr images. Backends supporting an automatic color stream can expose a directly displayable RGBA texture through [method set_color_stream_enabled]. Otherwise, environment camera backgrounds perform conversion automatically, while a [CameraTexture] displaying a separated feed exposes the component selected by [member which_feed] for conversion in a canvas shader.

method.name: is_color_stream_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this texture requested a directly displayable color stream from its feed.

method.name: set_color_stream_enabled
method.description: Requests a directly displayable RGBA stream from the selected feed. When enabled successfully, [member which_feed] is set to [constant CameraServer.FEED_COLOR_IMAGE]. The backend performs any required conversion; disabling the option releases this texture's request. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when the backend does not support automatic color conversion.

members.member: The ID of the [CameraFeed] for which we want to display the image.
Convenience property that gives access to the active property of the [CameraFeed].
Which image within the [CameraFeed] we want access to, important if the camera image is split in a Y and CbCr component.
